title: Bounded swaps in pass-and-swap queues: counterexamples to a conjecture of Dorsman and Gardner, and a proof for bipartite swapping graphs with odd caps under positive service rates
author: Anonymous
status: Unrefereed manuscript with written proofs and an exact, replayable verification package
main_results: Binding-move lemma: the orientation changes caused by capped service (necessity for all rates, exactness under positive rates); reduction of recurrence to a digraph on acyclic orientations under positive rates (Lemma 3.3, Corollary 3.4).
Pass-and-swap service equals (truncated) promotion on linear extensions (Proposition 3.5).
For every w >= 2 the balanced states of C_(2w+1) form a closed class of height w+1, recurrent under positive rates, with (2w+2)!/(w!)^2 states; Conjecture 1 is false for every w >= 2 (Theorem 4.1).

On C_n with cap w and positive rates, a recurrent class of height > w exists iff n = 1 (mod 2w), and it is the unique such class; for w >= 2 the conjecture therefore fails on C_n exactly when n = 1 (mod 2w) (Theorem 5.2).
Two odd cycles C_(2a+1), C_(2b+1) joined by a path of length L violate the conjecture at w = a+b+L+1 (Theorem 6.1).
For bipartite swapping graphs and odd w, under positive rates, every state of height > w is transient (Theorem 7.1).
Homogeneous rates: uniform global word independent of a binomial split on the balanced class, satisfying the source's partial-balance equations (Theorem 8.2, Proposition 8.3).
On the balanced class of C_(2w+1), for additive per-job rates and every w >= 2, orientation-scaled original product weights are stationary iff the rates are constant within each queue (Theorem 8.4).
certified_finite_results: Census of all connected graphs with at most 7 vertices: 1355 violating (graph, cap) pairs, none bipartite, none at w = 1.
No violation on any connected bipartite graph with at most 9 vertices, every cap (positive rates), and at most 7 vertices with head-only service.
Multiplicity examples (Table 4), deviation sizes and absorption probabilities on C_5 (Table 5).
open: Conjecture 7.2: bipartite swapping graphs, even caps.
General order-independent rates (head-only service) beyond the certified range.
Characterisation of all (G, w) with a recurrent class of excessive height.
